name: Progeni Bench
shortDescription: Progeni Bench brings 120 private browser tools for images, audio, files, data, crafts and productivity — running locally with no server uploads.
description: Progeni Bench is a private, client-side toolkit of 120 utilities: 30 legacy file, craft and data tools plus 42 image tools and 48 audio tools. It includes Avery label makers, sticker sheets, image resize/convert/compress, audio conversion, trimming, loudness analysis and recording, subtitle timing repair, CSV and vCard cleaning, QR and barcode generators, SVG optimisation and more. Every tool processes files in browser memory using Web Workers, Canvas, Web Audio and FFmpeg.wasm, so files are never uploaded to a server.
capabilities: 30 legacy utilities for labels, stickers, cross-stitch and diamond painting, subtitles, CSV and vCard cleanup, bookmarks, SVG and photos
42 image utilities for resizing, cropping, compressing, converting, watermarking, stripping metadata and optimising SVG
48 audio utilities for converting, trimming, joining, normalising, loudness (LUFS) analysis, recording and applying effects
Create printable Avery label sheets and custom label layouts from CSV or pasted data
Build sticker sheets with print-ready PNG, PDF and SVG exports
Create cross-stitch, embroidery and diamond-painting patterns from photos
Check subtitle reading speed and repair subtitle line breaks
Split CSV columns and standardise dates in spreadsheet exports
Deduplicate contact lists and split or merge vCard files
Generate and clean QR codes, barcodes and SVG assets
Find duplicate photos and rank burst shots using local image analysis
Record, convert, trim, join and analyse audio in the browser
All processing happens locally in the browser; there is no upload endpoint and no account

seo.title: Progeni Bench — 120 Private Browser Tools for Images, Audio, Files and Data
seo.description: Progeni Bench includes 120 free, private in-browser utilities for images, audio, labels, CSV, subtitles and more. Runs locally with no server uploads.

name: WaKit
shortDescription: Free client-side WhatsApp utilities: split 30-second status videos, open a chat without saving a number, generate QR and link codes, and compress audio to fit the 16 MB limit.
description: WaKit is a set of WhatsApp productivity tools that run entirely in the browser with WebAssembly. Split a long video into exact 30-second status clips with lossless FFmpeg stream copy, open a wa.me chat without adding a contact, generate WhatsApp chat links and QR codes, and transcode audio so it fits the 16 MB document limit. There is no upload endpoint: media is read from the file picker into browser memory and released when you clear the tool.
capabilities: Split videos into exact 30-second WhatsApp status clips with lossless stream copy
Open a WhatsApp chat from a phone number without saving it to contacts
Generate wa.me links and QR codes, including Wi-Fi and payment payloads
Compress audio to the 16 MB WhatsApp document limit with local FFmpeg transcoding

seo.title: WaKit — Private WhatsApp Status Splitter, Direct Chat, QR and Audio Tools
seo.description: Split WhatsApp status videos, message without saving numbers, generate QR codes and compress audio to 16 MB — in your browser, no uploads.
